alternativas.txt: Items that do not meet the defined acceptance criteria are rejected and properly disposed of by the laboratory.
Items are regularly checked to ensure they are still suitable for their intended use.
Items showing signs of deterioration are kept in use as long as there is no other available option.
The laboratory maintains records regarding the disposal and destination of discarded items.
All items are clearly identified throughout the entire time they are under the laboratory's responsibility.
